lines.trans: On the one hand, I work in a cool restaurant.
And on the other hand, you eat ordinary sausages.
Our chef cooks the most delicious food.
But total chaos always reigns in the kitchen.
Guests think this is the most peaceful place.
They will never know the truth about us.
Every customer considers themselves an important person.
And we simply pour them wine.
Work in the kitchen is very hard and nerve-wracking.
On the other hand, it's never boring here!
Our morning shift is starting soon.
Then prepare for a new workday!
I will prove to the chef that I know how to cook.

бывать.gloss: to happen, to be (sometimes); to visit

meanings.en: to happen, to exist, there can be
meanings.note: 3rd person бывает = there is / can be

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.
I grew up in a communal flat.
The bread rings are very tasty.

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.
We are simply preparing for the morning show.
The students were preparing for the exam.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.

meanings.note: что и требовалось доказать = Q.E.D., which is what needed to be proved

examples.trans: There, which is what needed to be proved!

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: В этом ресторане всегда свежая еда.
examples.trans: There is always fresh food in this restaurant.

meanings.note: not to be confused with есть 'there is' (from быть)

зато.gloss: but on the other hand, to make up for it

meanings.en: but on the other hand, at least

examples.text: Четыре по алгебре, зато по физкультуре пятёрка.
examples.trans: A four in algebra, but a five in gym.
The flat is small, but at least it's in the centre.
I was born and grew up here.
There's someone here to see you.
I'm working with clients right now.
This is only for regular clients.

examples.text: Раз ты такой крутой, познакомь нас!
examples.trans: Since you're so cool, introduce us!
Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.note: на его место = in his place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: + dative of the person, + accusative of the drink
goes right before the word it negates
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.text: Да нет на него никакого компромата. Обычный мужик.
examples.trans: There is no compromising material on him at all. Just an ordinary guy.

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.text: На столе стоял полный стакан воды.
examples.trans: A full glass of water stood on the table.

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine
работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.

meanings.note: morning or afternoon shift at school or work

examples.trans: We're on the afternoon shift today.

meanings.note: с другой стороны = on the other hand

examples.trans: On the other hand, it's interesting.
The shop is on that side.

считать.gloss: to count; to think, to consider

meanings.note: я считаю, что... = I think that...

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: I'll find out where he is.

уметь.gloss: to know how to, to be able to

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
